queer_characters.name: Elisa Sanchez Loriga
queer_characters.notes: Portrayed as a real historical lesbian woman who disguised herself as a man to legally marry Marcela in 1901 Spain; her disguise reflects the era's constraints rather than a trans identity per the source.

queer_characters.name: Marcela Gracia Ibeas
queer_characters.notes: Described as a real historical lesbian woman and Elisa's wife in the first recorded same-sex marriage in Spain.

contributor_notes: Based on a true story of the 1901 marriage of Elisa Sanchez Loriga and Marcela Gracia Ibeas. Note the plot involves Elisa disguising as a man for legal marriage — the source frames both women as lesbians, not as a trans narrative, but a maintainer may want to review this framing. Trigger warnings could also include parental separation (forced to leave their child), which isn't in the provided enum. A closing postscript notes same-sex relationships remain criminalized in many countries. Critical reception was mixed (47% RT). Subtitle availability not specified in source.
